top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The most recent inspection form was not posted.

top_violation_types.title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers (26 TAC §746.405(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have emergency telephone numbers posted.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

top_violation_types.title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The nap mats were not labeled with the children names.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.
